summary: Remove the unattested extra -le from mhalhéla-le
rationale: At 53/176 the matching sequence is “Nafiqo, mhalhela, əmmo”. The glossary adds an entire -le after mhalhéla; this is an extra clitic, not a difference in clitic boundaries, stress or vowel length. The supplied verse and inputs/texts/R053.txt agree on mhalhela. The grammar-page reference 799 is not independently available for comparison.

summary: Are 29/252 and 29/421 supplementary attestations rather than citations of the displayed quotation?

data.question: Should the two additional references be marked as supplementary attestations? No automatic reference deletion is proposed.

rationale: The displayed “mhalhele l-u=zʕuro” and “Da stimmte der Jüngling den Freudenruf an” match 29/129 exactly. The automatic other-verse warning at 29/252 is real as a quotation mismatch: that verse has the girl as subject and feminine mhalhela. The automatically found 29/421 instead has “mhalhele lu šex, u ḥolo du zʕuro”, with the uncle as subject. Both additional verses attest the same verb in the same stem, so they may be intentional supplementary references. The supplied evidence does not settle that editorial intention; retain them pending clarification rather than replace them with a duplicate 29/129.
